from solution import solve
import random
random.seed(1)
for _ in range(1000):
    n = random.randint(0, 30)
    xs = [random.randint(-1000, 1000) for _ in range(n)]
    if n == 0:
        expect = 0
    else:
        expect = sum(x * (((i+1) % n) + 1) for i, x in enumerate(xs)) % 97
    got = solve(xs)
    assert got == expect, (xs, got, expect)
print("all ok")

# Verify the two conditions on returned value
def check(xs):
    v = solve(xs)
    cond1 = (v == sum(1 for x in xs if x > v))
    cond2 = all(v > x for x in xs)
    return cond1 and cond2
